name: 00 Constraints
description: Uniqueness/key constraints. Run once before loading.

name: 01 Departments
description: Department reference nodes.

name: 02 Wards
description: Ward nodes, linked to their Department.
query:
:auto LOAD CSV WITH HEADERS FROM 'file:///clinical/Wards.csv' AS rec
CALL { WITH rec
  MERGE (w:Ward {ward_id: rec.ward_id})
  SET w.name = rec.name, w.ward_type = rec.ward_type,
      w.description = rec.description, w.department_id = rec.department_id
  WITH w, rec WHERE rec.department_id IS NOT NULL AND rec.department_id <> ''
  MATCH (d:Department {department_id: rec.department_id})
  MERGE (w)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(d)
} IN TRANSACTIONS OF 500 ROWS;

name: 03 Patients
description: Patient nodes (de-identified: sex, age, outcome).
query:
:auto LOAD CSV WITH HEADERS FROM 'file:///clinical/Patients.csv' AS rec
CALL { WITH rec
  MERGE (p:Patient {patient_id: rec.patient_id})
  SET p.sex = rec.sex,
      p.age_years = CASE WHEN rec.age_years <> '' THEN toInteger(rec.age_years) ELSE NULL END,
      p.deceased  = (rec.deceased = 'true')
} IN TRANSACTIONS OF 500 ROWS;

name: 04 Admissions
description: Admission nodes; Patient-[:HAS_ADMISSION]->Admission-[:ADMITTED_TO]->Ward.
query:
:auto LOAD CSV WITH HEADERS FROM 'file:///clinical/Admissions.csv' AS rec
CALL { WITH rec
  MERGE (a:Admission {admission_id: rec.admission_id})
  SET a.length_of_stay = CASE WHEN rec.length_of_stay <> '' THEN toInteger(rec.length_of_stay) ELSE NULL END
  WITH a, rec
  MATCH (p:Patient {patient_id: rec.patient_id})
  MERGE (p)-[:HAS_ADMISSION]->(a)
  WITH a, rec WHERE rec.ward_id IS NOT NULL AND rec.ward_id <> ''
  MATCH (w:Ward {ward_id: rec.ward_id})
  MERGE (a)-[:ADMITTED_TO]->(w)
} IN TRANSACTIONS OF 500 ROWS;

name: 05 Antibiotics
description: Antibiotic reference nodes.

name: 05b Antibiotic classes
description: AntibioticClass nodes; Antibiotic-[:BELONGS_TO]->AntibioticClass.
query:
:auto LOAD CSV WITH HEADERS FROM 'file:///clinical/AntibioticClasses.csv' AS rec
CALL { WITH rec
  MERGE (c:AntibioticClass {name: rec.class_name})
  WITH c, rec
  MATCH (ab:Antibiotic {antibiotic_id: rec.antibiotic_id})
  MERGE (ab)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(c)
} IN TRANSACTIONS OF 500 ROWS;

name: 06 Organisms
description: Organism (species) nodes, keyed by NCBI taxid.

name: 07 Specimens
description: Specimen nodes; Specimen-[:COLLECTED_FROM]->Patient.
query:
:auto LOAD CSV WITH HEADERS FROM 'file:///clinical/Specimens.csv' AS rec
CALL { WITH rec
  MERGE (s:Specimen {specimen_id: rec.specimen_id})
  SET s.specimen_type = rec.specimen_type, s.specimen_class = rec.specimen_class,
      s.category = rec.category,
      s.collection_date = CASE WHEN rec.collection_date <> '' THEN date(rec.collection_date) ELSE NULL END
  WITH s, rec WHERE rec.patient_id IS NOT NULL AND rec.patient_id <> ''
  MATCH (p:Patient {patient_id: rec.patient_id})
  MERGE (s)-[:COLLECTED_FROM]->(p)
} IN TRANSACTIONS OF 500 ROWS;

name: 08 Samples
description: Sample (isolate) nodes; DERIVED_FROM Specimen, IDENTIFIED_AS Organism.
query:
:auto LOAD CSV WITH HEADERS FROM 'file:///clinical/Samples.csv' AS rec
CALL { WITH rec
  MERGE (s:Sample {sample_id: rec.sample_id})
  WITH s, rec
  MATCH (sp:Specimen {specimen_id: rec.specimen_id})
  MERGE (s)-[:DERIVED_FROM]->(sp)
  WITH s, rec WHERE rec.organism_taxid IS NOT NULL AND rec.organism_taxid <> ''
  MATCH (o:Organism {taxid: rec.organism_taxid})
  MERGE (s)-[:IDENTIFIED_AS]->(o)
} IN TRANSACTIONS OF 500 ROWS;

name: 09 MIC / AST results
description: Antibiotic susceptibility as :LabResult:BacterialCulture; Specimen-[:TESTED_FOR]->LabResult-[:AGAINST]->Antibiotic.
query:
:auto LOAD CSV WITH HEADERS FROM 'file:///clinical/LabResults.csv' AS rec
CALL { WITH rec
  MERGE (lr:LabResult:BacterialCulture:MIC {lab_id: rec.lab_id})
  SET lr.result_type = rec.result_type,
      lr.test_date = CASE WHEN rec.test_date <> '' THEN date(rec.test_date) ELSE NULL END,
      lr.value = rec.value, lr.unit = rec.unit, lr.notes = rec.notes,
      lr.interpretation = rec.interpretation,
      lr.organism_taxid = rec.organism_taxid, lr.antibiotic_id = rec.antibiotic_id
  WITH lr, rec
  MATCH (s:Specimen {specimen_id: rec.specimen_id})
  MERGE (s)-[:TESTED_FOR]->(lr)
  WITH lr, rec WHERE rec.antibiotic_id IS NOT NULL AND rec.antibiotic_id <> ''
  MATCH (ab:Antibiotic {antibiotic_id: rec.antibiotic_id})
  MERGE (lr)-[:AGAINST]->(ab)
} IN TRANSACTIONS OF 500 ROWS;

name: 10 CBC (haematology)
description: Complete blood count as :LabResult:CBC; Admission-[:HAS_CBC]->CBC. All analyte columns become node properties.
query:
:auto LOAD CSV WITH HEADERS FROM 'file:///clinical/CBC.csv' AS rec
CALL { WITH rec
  MERGE (c:LabResult:CBC {cbc_id: rec.cbc_id})
  SET c.result_type = 'CBC', c += apoc.map.clean(rec, ['cbc_id','admission_id','patient_id'], ['',null])
  WITH c, rec
  MATCH (a:Admission {admission_id: rec.admission_id})
  MERGE (a)-[:HAS_CBC]->(c)
} IN TRANSACTIONS OF 500 ROWS;

name: 11 Terminology concepts (SNOMED CT)
description: SNOMED concept nodes. Each gets :SNOMED plus a semantic sub-label (Disorder/Finding/Situation/Device).
query:
:auto LOAD CSV WITH HEADERS FROM 'file:///clinical/Terminology.csv' AS rec
CALL { WITH rec
  MERGE (c:SNOMED {sctid: rec.sctid})
  SET c.preferred_term = rec.preferred_term,
      c.fully_specified_name = rec.fully_specified_name,
      c.semantic_tag = rec.semantic_tag
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN rec.concept_label = 'Disorder'  THEN [1] ELSE [] END | SET c:Disorder)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN rec.concept_label = 'Finding'   THEN [1] ELSE [] END | SET c:Finding)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN rec.concept_label = 'Situation' THEN [1] ELSE [] END | SET c:Situation)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN rec.concept_label = 'Device'    THEN [1] ELSE [] END | SET c:Device)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN rec.concept_label = 'Morphology' THEN [1] ELSE [] END | SET c:Morphology)
} IN TRANSACTIONS OF 500 ROWS;

name: 12 Patient conditions
description: Patient-level SNOMED links: comorbid disorders (HAS_DISORDER), clinical findings incl. outcome (HAS_CLINICAL_FINDING), and clinical history (HAS_CLINICAL_HISTORY).
query:
:auto LOAD CSV WITH HEADERS FROM 'file:///clinical/PatientConditions.csv' AS rec
CALL { WITH rec
  MATCH (p:Patient {patient_id: rec.patient_id})
  MATCH (c:SNOMED {sctid: rec.sctid})
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN rec.relationship = 'HAS_DISORDER'         THEN [1] ELSE [] END | MERGE (p)-[:HAS_DISORDER]->(c))
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN rec.relationship = 'HAS_CLINICAL_FINDING' THEN [1] ELSE [] END | MERGE (p)-[:HAS_CLINICAL_FINDING]->(c))
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN rec.relationship = 'HAS_CLINICAL_HISTORY' THEN [1] ELSE [] END | MERGE (p)-[:HAS_CLINICAL_HISTORY]->(c))
} IN TRANSACTIONS OF 500 ROWS;

name: 13 Admission conditions
description: Admission-level SNOMED links: principal diagnosis (HAS_PRINCIPAL_DIAGNOSIS) and medical devices used (USE_DEVICE).
query:
:auto LOAD CSV WITH HEADERS FROM 'file:///clinical/AdmissionConditions.csv' AS rec
CALL { WITH rec
  MATCH (a:Admission {admission_id: rec.admission_id})
  MATCH (c:SNOMED {sctid: rec.sctid})
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN rec.relationship = 'HAS_PRINCIPAL_DIAGNOSIS' THEN [1] ELSE [] END | MERGE (a)-[:HAS_PRINCIPAL_DIAGNOSIS]->(c))
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN rec.relationship = 'USE_DEVICE'              THEN [1] ELSE [] END | MERGE (a)-[:USE_DEVICE]->(c))
} IN TRANSACTIONS OF 500 ROWS;

name: 14 Assembly
description: Genome assembly nodes; Sample-[:HAS_ASSEMBLY]->Assembly.
query:
:auto LOAD CSV WITH HEADERS FROM 'file:///genomics/Assembly.csv' AS rec
CALL { WITH rec
  MERGE (a:Assembly {assembly_id: rec.assembly_id})
  SET a.date = CASE WHEN rec.date <> '' THEN date(rec.date) ELSE NULL END,
      a.assembler = rec.assembler,
      a.sequencing_technology = rec.sequencing_technology,
      a.annotation_source = rec.annotation_source
  WITH a, rec
  MATCH (s:Sample {sample_id: rec.sample_id})
  MERGE (s)-[:HAS_ASSEMBLY]->(a)
} IN TRANSACTIONS OF 500 ROWS;

name: 14b Sequencing reads (BioDataFile)
description: Raw read files referenced by placeholder URI (the reads themselves are not shipped); Assembly-[:ASSEMBLED_FROM]->BioDataFile.
query:
:auto LOAD CSV WITH HEADERS FROM 'file:///genomics/BioDataFiles.csv' AS rec
CALL { WITH rec
  MERGE (f:BioDataFile {uri: rec.uri})
  SET f.file_type = rec.file_type, f.read_type = rec.read_type, f.compressed = rec.compressed
  WITH f, rec
  MATCH (a:Assembly {assembly_id: rec.assembly_id})
  MERGE (a)-[:ASSEMBLED_FROM]->(f)
} IN TRANSACTIONS OF 500 ROWS;

name: 15 Resistance genes
description: AMR genes detected in each assembly; Assembly-[:FOUND]->Gene. (AMR is a public NosoGraph extension.)
query:
:auto LOAD CSV WITH HEADERS FROM 'file:///genomics/ResistanceGenes.csv' AS rec
CALL { WITH rec
  MERGE (g:Gene {name: rec.gene})
  WITH g, rec
  MATCH (a:Assembly {assembly_id: rec.assembly_id})
  MERGE (a)-[f:FOUND]->(g)
  SET f.annotation_source = rec.annotation_source, f.annotation_method = rec.annotation_method
} IN TRANSACTIONS OF 500 ROWS;

name: 16 Features (annotated genes)
description: Genome features/genes keyed by locus_tag (curated to resistance-relevant loci, incl. penA).
query:
:auto LOAD CSV WITH HEADERS FROM 'file:///genomics/Features.csv' AS rec
CALL { WITH rec
  MERGE (f:Feature {locus_tag: rec.locus_tag})
  SET f.name = rec.name, f.product = rec.product,
      f.reference_accession = rec.reference_accession,
      f.start = CASE WHEN rec.start <> '' THEN toInteger(rec.start) ELSE NULL END,
      f.end   = CASE WHEN rec.end   <> '' THEN toInteger(rec.end)   ELSE NULL END,
      f.strand = rec.strand
} IN TRANSACTIONS OF 500 ROWS;

name: 17 Variant-calling runs
description: Snippy variant-calling runs; Sample-[:HAS]->VariantCallingRun.
query:
:auto LOAD CSV WITH HEADERS FROM 'file:///genomics/VariantCallingRuns.csv' AS rec
CALL { WITH rec
  MERGE (vcr:ProcessRun:VariantCallingRun {process_run_id: rec.run_id})
  SET vcr.process = 'variant_calling', vcr.tool = rec.software, vcr.run_id = rec.run_id,
      vcr.date = CASE WHEN rec.run_date <> '' THEN date(rec.run_date) ELSE NULL END
  WITH vcr, rec
  MATCH (s:Sample {sample_id: rec.sample_id})
  MERGE (s)-[:HAS]->(vcr)
} IN TRANSACTIONS OF 500 ROWS;

name: 18 Variants
description: Called variants; VariantCallingRun-[:CALLED]->Variant-[:AFFECTS]->Feature.
query:
:auto LOAD CSV WITH HEADERS FROM 'file:///genomics/Variants.csv' AS rec
CALL { WITH rec
  MERGE (v:Variant {variant_id: rec.variant_id})
  SET v.reference_accession = rec.reference_accession,
      v.pos = CASE WHEN rec.pos <> '' THEN toInteger(rec.pos) ELSE NULL END,
      v.ref = rec.ref, v.alt = rec.alt, v.variant_type = rec.variant_type,
      v.effect = rec.effect, v.impact = rec.impact,
      v.hgvs_c = rec.hgvs_c, v.hgvs_p = rec.hgvs_p
  WITH v, rec
  MATCH (vcr:VariantCallingRun {process_run_id: rec.run_id})
  MERGE (vcr)-[:CALLED]->(v)
  WITH v, rec WHERE rec.feature_locus_tag IS NOT NULL AND rec.feature_locus_tag <> ''
  MATCH (f:Feature {locus_tag: rec.feature_locus_tag})
  MERGE (v)-[:AFFECTS]->(f)
} IN TRANSACTIONS OF 500 ROWS;

name: Clinical–genomic spine
description: Patient -> Specimen -> Sample -> Assembly, with organism and ward.
query:
MATCH (p:Patient)<-[:COLLECTED_FROM]-(sp:Specimen)<-[:DERIVED_FROM]-(s:Sample)-[:HAS_ASSEMBLY]->(a:Assembly)
OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[:IDENTIFIED_AS]->(o:Organism)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:HAS_ADMISSION]->(:Admission)-[:ADMITTED_TO]->(w:Ward)
RETURN p.patient_id AS patient, p.sex AS sex, p.age_years AS age, w.name AS ward,
       sp.specimen_type AS specimen, s.sample_id AS sample, o.sciname AS organism,
       a.assembly_id AS assembly
ORDER BY patient;

name: AMR phenotype vs. genotype
description: MIC interpretation per antibiotic alongside the resistance genes carried by the same isolate.
query:
MATCH (s:Sample)-[:DERIVED_FROM]->(sp:Specimen)-[:TESTED_FOR]->(lr:LabResult:BacterialCulture)-[:AGAINST]->(ab:Antibiotic)
OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[:HAS_ASSEMBLY]->(:Assembly)-[:FOUND]->(g:Gene)
RETURN s.sample_id AS sample, ab.class AS drug_class, ab.name AS antibiotic,
       lr.value AS mic, lr.interpretation AS sir, collect(DISTINCT g.name) AS resistance_genes
ORDER BY sample, drug_class;

name: Patient comorbidity & outcome profile
description: SNOMED disorders, principal diagnosis, devices, and outcome per patient.
query:
MATCH (p:Patient)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:HAS_DISORDER]->(d:SNOMED:Disorder)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:HAS_ADMISSION]->(a:Admission)-[:HAS_PRINCIPAL_DIAGNOSIS]->(pd:SNOMED)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:USE_DEVICE]->(dev:SNOMED:Device)
RETURN p.patient_id AS patient, p.deceased AS died, a.length_of_stay AS los_days,
       pd.preferred_term AS principal_diagnosis,
       collect(DISTINCT d.preferred_term) AS comorbidities,
       collect(DISTINCT dev.preferred_term) AS devices
ORDER BY patient;

name: Beta-lactam resistance: MIC phenotype + penA genotype
description: Equivalent of the gold NosoWatch penA query in the public schema: link the penicillin β-lactam antibiotic class, through MIC susceptibility, to an isolate carrying a penA variant.
query:
MATCH graph =
  (:AntibioticClass {name: 'penicillin beta-lactam'})<-[:BELONGS_TO]-(:Antibiotic)
  <-[:AGAINST]-(:LabResult:MIC)<-[:TESTED_FOR]-(:Specimen)
  <-[:DERIVED_FROM]-(:Sample)-[:HAS]->(:VariantCallingRun)
  -[:CALLED]->(:Variant)-[:AFFECTS]->(:Feature {name: 'penA'})
RETURN graph;

name: Pan-drug-resistant isolates
description: Isolates resistant (R) to every antibiotic tested — the surveillance red flag.
query:
MATCH (s:Sample)-[:DERIVED_FROM]->(:Specimen)-[:TESTED_FOR]->(lr:LabResult:BacterialCulture)
WITH s, count(lr) AS tested, sum(CASE WHEN lr.interpretation = 'R' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resistant
WHERE tested = resistant AND tested > 0
MATCH (s)-[:IDENTIFIED_AS]->(o:Organism)
RETURN s.sample_id AS sample, o.sciname AS organism, tested AS antibiotics_tested
ORDER BY sample;

name: ① Clinical backbone
description: Patient → Admission → Ward → Department, plus the specimen collected from each patient.

name: ② Specimen → susceptibility
description: How a specimen links to its isolate and to the antibiotics it was tested against (with drug class).

name: ③ Patient conditions (SNOMED)
description: A patient's comorbidities, clinical history and outcome, plus the admission's principal diagnosis and devices.

name: ④ Clinical–genomic spine
description: The join that makes NosoGraph useful: patient context all the way to the sequenced genome.

name: ⑤ Resistance genotype
description: Acquired AMR genes on the assembly and chromosomal variants in resistance-relevant features.

name: ⑥ One isolate, everything
description: The full ego-network around a single isolate — clinical context + genotype in one picture. Change the sample_id.
query:
MATCH graph = (s:Sample {sample_id: 'sample_01'})-[*1..4]-(neighbour)
RETURN graph;
